A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (type line and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-onemorepass-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[One More Pass]] (November 1996): The game text changes: “Add” becomes “If you are about to draw power harpoon weapon destiny, add”; “one” is added after “Add ability of”; “to Power Harpoon weapon destiny (before weapon destiny is drawn).” becomes “aboard same vehicle.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•One More Pass” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
